UNIIVERSITIES ACT, No. 16 OF 1978
Order under Section 25A

BY virtue of powers vested in me by Section 25A of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978 I, Dr. Sarath Amunugama, the Ministerof Higher Education and Research, having obtained a report under Section 70 C of the aforesaid Act, in respect of the SouthAsian Institute of Technology and Medicine (Pvt.) Ltd. (SAITM) a company incorporated in Sri Lanka under the CompaniesAct, No. 7 of 2007 and bearing Registration Number PV 64641, do by this Order and subject to the conditions specified inSchedule I hereto, recognize the South Asian Institute of Technology and Medicine (Pvt.) Ltd. (SAITM) as a DegreeAwarding Institute for the purpose of developing higher education therein, leading to the award of the Degrees specified inColumn I of the Schedule II hereto, of which the abbreviations are set out in the corresponding entries respectively inColumn II of the Schedule II hereto.
SCHEDULE I
CONDITIONS
(1) SAITM - South Asian Institute of Technology and Medicine (Pvt.) Limited (hereinafter referred to as the “Institute”)
shall before the expiry of two months from the date of granting the degree awarding status, submit its Article ofAssociation duly amended as set out below to the specified Authority :–
(a) to specify higher education as an object in the Article of Association ;
(b) to undertake to inform the Specific Authority of Voluntary winding up of the Company prior to such winding
up.
(2) The Institute shall before the expiry of Twelve months (12) from the date of granting the degree awarding status,
submit the following details to Specified Authority :-
(i) proof of recruitment of qualified academic and non-academic staff as to meet the requirements of the relevant
degree programme ;

(ii) a study program for the specified period of study in accordance with the norms approved by the University
Grants Commission ;
(iii) proof of the availability of the text books, hand books, recommended reading books and other sufficient
learning materials required for the relevant degree programme ;
(iv) proof of availability of spacious modernized library with all required collection of books and materials, which
would enable students who carry out and the required of researches for the relevant degree programme ; and
(v) specifying the requirement for the staff to engage in relevant researches and publish such researches in
journals in Sri Lanka.
(3) The Institute shall before the expiry of 03 years from the date of granting the degree awarding status, establish the
following laboratories required to the Engineering Bachelor of Science (Hons.) in Civil Engineering Degree Programme.
(i) Material and Mechanics Laboratory,(ii) Surveying Laboratory,(iii) Structural Testing Laboratory,(iv) Geotechnical Laboratory,
(v) Hydraulic Laboratory.
(4) Establishment of Laboratories : SAITM shall increase following laboratory facilities before completion of second
academic year of the first batch of student enrolment and obtain approval of specified Authority :
(i) Robotics and Artificial Intelligence Lab(ii) Industrial Automation and Process Control Lab(iii) Electronics, Instrumentation and Power System Lab(iv) Engineering Workshop.
(5) Evidence of Quality Assurance Mechanism implementation shall be submitted on an half yearly basis and full
implementation evidence shall be submitted within one year of enrolling first batch.
SCHEDULE II

Bachelor of Science in Engineering in Mechatronics Engineering DegreeBSc (Eng.) (Mechatronics Eng.)

In this Order “the Specified Authority” means the Secretary to the Minister of the Minister assigned the subject ofHigher Education and Research.
Dr. SARATH AMUNUGAMA,Minister of Higher Education and Research.
06th May, 2015,Colombo.
